title: Benchmark manifest row
description: One row per ligand-target pair. Produced by WP-A (stage S0); consumed by every other work package. Frozen at the start of the hackathon; changes require an ADR.

ligand_id.description: Stable key assigned once by WP-A. Never regenerated from SMILES.

target_id.description: UniProt accession + gene + construct tag, e.g. P50750_CDK9_full

smiles.description: Canonical SMILES, RDKit canonicalisation, version recorded in curation_notes.md

activity_value.description: Numeric activity. Null for decoys and for binary-only rows.

assay_id.description: Source assay identifier. Required when activity_value is present - selectivity ratios across unknown assays are not valid.

assay_atp_conc_uM.description: ATP concentration. Kinase IC50 is meaningless for cross-target comparison without it.

selectivity_class.description: Coarse label. 'non_selective' (real binders lacking discrimination) are the discriminating negatives - see data-sources.md.

decoy_matched_to.description: ligand_id this decoy was property-matched against

scaffold_id.description: Bemis-Murcko scaffold key, for leave-one-scaffold-out folds

cocrystal_deposited.description: Deposition date. Entries postdating a model's training cutoff are the only honest held-out set - see fidelity-contracts.md contract 1.

curation_note.description: Any judgement call made for this row. Free text, but not optional when a judgement was made.
